title: robot engset
summary: Exactly 10 robots can independently originate a remote-maintenance session only while not already in a session. For each idle robot, session requests are Poisson at rate 0.5 per hour; each occupied technician has exponential session time with mean 1 hour. If all technicians are occupied, a new request is blocked and lost. The team needs the smallest technician count with per-request blocking probability below 5%, accounting for the finite source population rather than treating arrivals as an infinite external stream.
